artifact_contract.canonical_payload: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, excluding volatile timestamps and self-hash fields
artifact_contract.immutability: An existing non-identical seal is never overwritten.

claim_boundary.allowed: A provider-neutral reversible gate IR implements the sealed exact dyadic BANDS feasibility predicate and passes the declared semantic and clean-ancilla controls.

compiler.canonical_serialization: One JSON object per gate with stable register indices; SHA-256 is streamed over compact sorted-key JSON lines.
compiler.constant_addition: Controlled addition modulo 2^w synthesized as descending multi-controlled increments for each set bit of the two's-complement constant.
compiler.gate_set_boundary: MCX is an abstract reversible gate with an exact clean-ancilla v-chain decomposition contract; backend-native lowering is V3.3.
compiler.inclusive_comparator: Disjoint lexicographic prefix terms plus equality; signed order is obtained by virtual inversion of the two's-complement sign bit.
compiler.negative_controls: Control polarity is explicit in every MCX record and is lowered by paired X gates around the positive-control network.
compiler.reference_compiler_priority: Correctness, determinism and auditability before optimization.

resource_decomposition.mcx_clean_ancilla_v_chain: For m controls: m=0 -> X; m=1 -> CX; m=2 -> CCX; m>=3 -> 2m-3 CCX and m-2 clean decomposition ancillas. Negative controls add two X gates each.
resource_decomposition.scope: Fault-tolerant estimates only; logical IR width and optional decomposition-ancilla width are reported separately.

gate_compiler_spec_version: PHASE III · PROOF-CARRYING REVERSIBLE GATE COMPILER SPEC · V1

hash_contract.legacy_identifier: First 20 uppercase hexadecimal characters of gate_compiler_spec_sha256

oracle_contract.ancilla_postcondition: Every work, comparator, constraint-flag and aggregate qubit returns to |0> for every computational-basis input.
oracle_contract.bounds: All group and factor comparisons are inclusive: lower <= value <= upper.
oracle_contract.constant_encoding: Signed constants are represented modulo 2^w in exact two's complement; source dyadic integers are never rounded.

domain_variants.EXACT_K_SUBSPACE: f(x) is the conjunction of four group-count and three exact dyadic factor-band predicates; the contract domain is D_K={x: popcount(x)=K}.
domain_variants.FULL_BINARY: f(x) additionally includes popcount(x)=K, yielding the complete Phase-II strict BANDS feasibility predicate over all x in {0,1}^N.

oracle_contract.endianness: little-endian within every register; register index 0 is the least-significant bit
oracle_contract.input_preparation: State preparation is outside U_f and must never be hidden inside the oracle.
oracle_contract.overflow: Arithmetic is modulo 2^w, but certified widths must contain every allowed partial sum, both inclusive bounds, and zero; any failed range proof blocks compilation.
oracle_contract.qubit_indexing: contiguous global zero-based indices assigned by canonical register order
oracle_contract.work_register_policy: Sequential reuse across constraints; no factor/group accumulator remains live after its flag is computed.

parent_contract.legacy_parent_validation: Recompute every seed certificate SHA and the embedded dyadic oracle SHA; never trust status strings or stored hash fields alone.
parent_contract.required_fidelity_status: EXACT DYADIC FAMILY PASS · BY CONSTRUCTION

preregistration.development_cases: Synthetic small-N cases and noncanonical seeds only before spec seal.

validation_ladder.A_ARITHMETIC: Exhaustive small-width increment, signed constant addition and inclusive comparator tests.
validation_ladder.B_SEED: All eight N=40 seed certificates, authoritative witnesses, deterministic exact-K controls, flag decomposition and clean-ancilla checks.
validation_ladder.C_SMALL_N_EXHAUSTIVE: Zero mismatches for both EXACT_K_SUBSPACE over D_K and FULL_BINARY over all 2^N inputs.
validation_ladder.D_N40_CONTROLS: Witnesses, deterministic boundary/adversarial vectors and preregistered implementation controls; sampling is never called a proof.
validation_ladder.E_REPRODUCIBILITY: Two independent compilations must produce identical gate IR hashes, resource ledgers and validation hashes.
